subject: general
question: What is the primary focus of the ‘Inclusive India Summit’ organized on Global Accessibility Awareness Day 2025?

options.text: Promotion of inclusive development and digital accessibility

solution:
The Correct Answer is ​ __**Promotion of inclusive development and digital accessibility**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ‘Inclusive India Summit’ to be organized on Global Accessibility Awareness Day, on May 15, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Organized by:** Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

 
 
• 
 
**Occasion:** **Global Accessibility Awareness Day (GAAD)** — observed annually on the **third Thursday of May** (May 15, 2025).

 
 
• 
 
**Event Name:** **Inclusive India Summit.**

 
 
• 
 
**Mode:** **Hybrid.**

 
 
• 
 
**Venue:** India International Centre, **New Delhi.**
